_comment: RATCHET-ONLY-DOWN (see scripts/check-mock-cast-escape.mjs). Raising this is a deliberate hand-edit with a justification, never an automatic write. Regenerate with --update on a quiet tree. JUSTIFIED RAISE 1065 -> 1076 (WI-6730): the scan switched from a bare `git ls-files` pathspec (which does not recurse into submodules) to the shared listTrackedFiles() helper, which does — surfacing 11 pre-existing occurrences in libs/generic/**, libs/papercusp/**, and papercusp-desktop/** that were always there but previously invisible to this guard. Not a new escape hatch; a coverage fix. JUSTIFIED RAISE 1076 -> 1087 (EI-20059456952698638): the detector was rewritten from a hand-rolled string/comment masker + anchored regex to a TypeScript AST walk, because the old lexer was blind in two ways that both failed silently toward `clean` — a regex literal containing a quote blanked the rest of the file, and the `$` anchor in /\bas\s+(never|any)\s*$/ could not match a cast followed by the trailing comma prettier emits for every multi-line call. Measured line-aligned across all 6,372 tracked test files: the AST reproduces EVERY finding the old detector made (zero coverage lost) and recovers 13 escapes it could not see; a sample was hand-read at the source to confirm each is a genuine `as never` closing a mock install. On the same tree the old detector counted 1074, so this baseline was also 2 stale-high. Not new debt: 13 pre-existing escapes that were always there and are only now visible.
